description: What a Base wallet holds: ETH plus USDC, USDbC, DAI, WETH, cbBTC, AERO and DEGEN balances with USD values and a total, read live (address=0x...). For portfolio, risk and counterparty agents that need a quick holdings check without an indexer key. Pay per call $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.

address.description: wallet or contract address on Base, e.g. 0xd0b53D9277642d899DF5C87A3966A349A798F224; if omitted, this example is answered

x_payment.description: signed x402 payment (X-PAYMENT header value); omit on the first call to receive the price and payment requirements
